sections.description: This is just an example plugin to test updates
sections.installation:
1. Upload the `example-plugin` folder to the `/wp-content/plugins/` directory.
2. Activate the plugin through the 'Plugins' menu in WordPress.
3. Update as needed
sections.frequently_asked_questions:
= How do I modify the settings =
There ae no settings on this plugin
sections.changelog:
• # Changelog
  • All notable changes to **Example Plugin** are recorded here.
  • > **Example only:** The entries below are fictional demonstration release notes for testing the GitHub + EDD deployment workflow. Replace them with actual changes before publishing.
  • ## [1.0.2] - 2026-10-26
  • ### Fixed
  • - Corrected an issue where saved plugin settings were not consistently loaded.
  • - Improved error handling when the update service is temporarily unavailable.
  • ### Changed
  • - Refined admin notices to make update results easier to understand.
  • ## [1.0.1] - 2026-10-20
  • ### Fixed
  • - Resolved a compatibility warning on newer PHP versions.
  • - Fixed a minor issue with version information displayed in the dashboard.
  • ### Changed
  • - Improved logging for unsuccessful update checks.
  • ## [1.0.0] - 2026-10-15
  • ### Added
  • - First stable release of Example Plugin.
  • - Automatic update checks through the configured update service.
  • - Settings page for core plugin options.
  • ### Changed
  • - Finalised the admin interface and configuration defaults.
  • - Improved input validation and sanitisation.
  • ## [0.9.0] - 2026-10-01
  • ### Added
  • - Initial public beta release.
  • - Basic plugin functionality and settings storage.
  • - Preliminary updater integration for testing.
  • ### Known limitations
  • - Beta functionality and update delivery required further testing.
